mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_like WHERE user_id=#{user} AND note_id=#{note}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_like WHERE user_id=#{user} AND note_id=#{note}) AS liked,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_favorite WHERE user_id=#{user2} AND note_id=#{note2}) AS favorite,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_follow f JOIN t_note n ON n.author_id=f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id=#{user3} AND n.id=#{note3}) AS following,COALESCE((SELECT like_count FROM t_note_metric WHERE note_id=#{note4}),0) AS like_count,COALESCE((SELECT favorite_count FROM t_note_metric WHERE note_id=#{note5}),0) AS favorite_count,COALESCE((SELECT comment_count FROM t_note_metric WHERE note_id=#{note6}),0) AS comment_count
